_comment: Debug logging. `env`: values of KEENABLE_LOG, each [value, whether it turns debug logging on, why]; only "debug", trimmed and in any letter case, does. `lines`: one attempt and the line logged for it. The fields come in this order: method, path (the URL's path as sent, never the host or query), attempt (1 for the first), then status (the HTTP status) or error (timeout, redirect, canceled or connection, when no status counts), elapsed_ms (whole milliseconds, truncated), retry (true or false), wait_ms (only when retry is true; whole milliseconds, truncated), request_id (left out when there is none, or when it is longer than 128 characters or has a character outside printable ASCII, 0x21 to 0x7E). Python and Rust log the part after "keenable: " as the message of the `keenable` logger (log target); Go logs the same fields as slog attributes with the message "keenable". Never logged: the API key, any header, the query string, a body.

lines.name: a first attempt that succeeds
lines.line: keenable: method=POST path=/v1/search attempt=1 status=200 elapsed_ms=123 retry=false request_id=req_1

lines.name: a 503 that is retried after a wait
lines.line: keenable: method=POST path=/v1/fetch/public attempt=1 status=503 elapsed_ms=40 retry=true wait_ms=437 request_id=req_2

lines.name: a third attempt that fails for good, with no request id
lines.line: keenable: method=GET path=/v1/billing attempt=3 status=500 elapsed_ms=0 retry=false

lines.name: a timeout
lines.line: keenable: method=POST path=/v1/search attempt=1 error=timeout elapsed_ms=30000 retry=true wait_ms=500

lines.name: a refused redirect
lines.line: keenable: method=DELETE path=/v1/monitors/mon_1 attempt=1 error=redirect elapsed_ms=9 retry=false

lines.name: a connection failure
lines.line: keenable: method=PATCH path=/v1/monitors/mon_1 attempt=2 error=connection elapsed_ms=1 retry=false

lines.name: a 429 waited out for its Retry-After
lines.line: keenable: method=POST path=/v1/search attempt=1 status=429 elapsed_ms=15 retry=true wait_ms=3000 request_id=req_3

lines.name: a request id with a space is left out
lines.line: keenable: method=POST path=/v1/search attempt=1 status=200 elapsed_ms=5 retry=false

lines.name: a request id outside ASCII is left out
lines.line: keenable: method=POST path=/v1/search attempt=1 status=200 elapsed_ms=5 retry=false

lines.name: a request id of 128 characters is kept
lines.line: keenable: method=POST path=/v1/search attempt=1 status=200 elapsed_ms=5 retry=false request_id=rrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrr

lines.name: a request id of 129 characters is left out
lines.line: keenable: method=POST path=/v1/search attempt=1 status=200 elapsed_ms=5 retry=false
